scope: Three heritage/lived-route dossiers; hotel and museum interiors remain permission-controlled and Barranco conditions require same-day verification.

sources.supports: Current operation, 1927 history, former golf/polo garden relationship and continuing transformation.
Current living-gallery use of more than 300 viceregal artworks in hotel circulation since 1999.
Current public restaurant operation daily 06:30–23:00; does not authorize hotel-wide photography.
Current municipal attraction identity and bridge/Bajada relationship; exact repair and congestion state remains field verification.
Raised double-stair façade, gallery, rest-house origin and occupation by San Martín/Bolívar.
Published open museum operation at Plaza Bolívar and group-reservation workflow; reverify current hours before route use.

contradictions: Restaurant hours establish a public hospitality threshold but not unrestricted access to guest, gallery or garden areas and not architectural-photography permission.
Operator history describes former golf/polo relationships that may no longer read spatially in one current frame.
composition_questions: Can present arrival or service movement make the 1927 hotel's social threshold and living-gallery adaptation legible without becoming luxury promotion?
Which vehicle, doorman overlap, artwork, furniture or guest cluster would hide the entry–hall–gallery sequence?
Does moving between exterior stair, lobby threshold and restaurant/public edge reveal hospitality causality better than widening a symmetrical frontal view?

source_truth.answer: Country Club Lima Hotel is an operating 1927 San Isidro hotel whose gardens historically connected to golf and polo and whose spaces continue to change.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The formal central arrival, wings, gardens and club/hotel rooms organized lodging, sport and elite social gathering while anchoring surrounding urbanization.

current_life.answer: The hotel, public restaurant and event spaces actively receive guests and diners; exact non-guest circulation and photography conditions require confirmation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Arrive, receive, carry, check in, dine, meet and look are current. The decisive relation is guest/service passage through an art-bearing hospitality threshold.

architectural_causality.answer: Central stairs, entry court, lobby axes, wings and garden thresholds turn arrival into a graduated social ritual and distribute hotel functions.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Empty symmetrical façade, luxury lobby and artwork detail dominate. The underused frame links current service/arrival to the formal threshold and living-gallery circulation.

light_material_geometry.answer: Soft daylight can articulate entry depth and historic surfaces; low interior light can separate artwork and moving figures without turning the hotel into ambience.

position_then_optics.answer: With approval test public exterior stair, lobby/restaurant threshold and assigned gallery edge. Start 50 mm for person/device, 35 mm for entry depth and 85 mm only from a lawful distant position for layered service/art.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Request hotel approval, use a restaurant reservation only for ordinary dining access, avoid guest faces/rooms and staff disruption, and fall back to public exterior if deliberate photography is declined.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when formal hotel architecture visibly channels present hospitality and cultural display. Luxury décor, façade symmetry or celebrity history alone fails.

The former funicular is documentary context only; it must be rejected as a scene mechanism unless physical residue is visible without caption.
composition_questions: Can simultaneous crossing above and descending below make the bridge legible as one layer in a topographic movement system?
Which vendor awning, portrait queue, vegetation overlap or clipped path would sever bridge from Bajada?
Does moving below/alongside the bridge reveal crossing-over-descent causality better than changing focal length from the iconic frontal viewpoint?

source_truth.answer: Puente de los Suspiros crosses the older Bajada de Baños ravine route in Barranco, joining upper neighborhood edges above a persistent descent toward the coast.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The timber crossing links opposite upper sides while the Bajada preserves longitudinal descent, creating two perpendicular movement systems at different levels.

current_life.answer: The municipality presents both as active attractions and pedestrian routes; exact crowd, commerce and repair conditions remain same-day checks.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, descend, climb, pause, meet, sell and look are credible. The decisive relation is one body crossing above while another follows the constrained descent below.

architectural_causality.answer: Bridge deck, ravine walls, narrow path, stairs and openings separate transverse connection from longitudinal topographic flow.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Centered bridge portraits, romantic couples and picturesque descent views dominate. The underused frame works below/oblique to show two simultaneous movement systems.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can simplify saturated color/clutter and emphasize timber-over-ravine depth; lateral light can separate bridge deck, walls and descending figures.

position_then_optics.answer: Verify lower oblique beside Bajada, upper side edge and distant descent alignment. Start 50 mm for crossing/descending relation, 35 mm for full section and 85 mm from distance only if both routes remain legible.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Visit early or in garúa, verify repairs and safe standing area, never obstruct the narrow corridor, avoid identifiable children/couples and cap waiting at 20 minutes.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when architecture/topography visibly produces crossing over descent. An iconic bridge, romance ritual or vendor scene without the section fails.

contradictions: Published government hours/reservation guidance must be reverified before route use and does not establish interior photography conditions.
Historical political occupation is well documented but cannot rescue a frame whose raised-house and visitor sequence are not visually legible.
composition_questions: Can the double stair, raised gallery and room threshold visibly transform state-house arrival into a contemporary museum route?
Which garden planting, display case, visitor overlap or bright doorway would disconnect approach from raised veranda and interior destination?
Does moving from frontal façade center to the stair/gallery diagonal reveal inhabitation more clearly than widening the whole house?

source_truth.answer: Quinta de los Libertadores is the raised historic Pueblo Libre residence occupied by San Martín and Bolívar and used as the MNAAHP Independence hall/visitor site.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A double stair lifts visitors to a screened gallery and main rooms, organizing formal arrival, rest, reception and governance above the garden.

current_life.answer: Government sources document museum visitation and group reservation; current hours, exhibit state and photography rules require direct confirmation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Approach, climb, enter, guide, observe, learn and wait are credible. The decisive relation is a visitor ascending from garden level toward the raised historical/museum sequence.

architectural_causality.answer: Double stairs, elevation above grade, veranda/gallery and aligned room thresholds ritualize approach and separate garden/public arrival from interior reception.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Empty heritage façade, period-room object and romantic night garden dominate. The underused frame makes ascent through the raised threshold the story.

light_material_geometry.answer: Soft daylight reveals quincha surfaces, stair symmetry and veranda depth; hard frontal light or decorative night illumination flattens the transition.

position_then_optics.answer: With permission test garden diagonal to one stair, veranda end toward rooms and interior threshold. Start 50 mm for ascent/device, 35 mm for garden-house section and 85 mm for layered visitor/gallery from distance.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Reverify opening/reservation and photography policy, remain with visitor route, avoid flash/objects and identifiable children, and use garden-only fallback if interior work is declined.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when raised domestic/state architecture visibly choreographs present learning. A famous-house façade or object display without movement fails.

A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Clear interval reveals vertical arrival sequence
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Control plants, railings and clipped façade
